## Relationships

### [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/martin-crawford--rosemary-west.md)

Martin Crawford and [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) are romantically involved, having professed their love and made promises to one another eighteen years prior. However, their situation is complicated by a solemn vow [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) made to her sister [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) ten years ago never to marry. When [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) unexpectedly proposes to [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md), she finds herself unable to refuse him directly because she realizes she loves him, leading her to ask for a few days to consider the proposal.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P66](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0066), [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P0](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD P24](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0024), +3 more_
